cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm managing Mum's birthday invitations. Remind me what time I booked the room; I'm checking everyone has the right details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. And which restaurant name are you using? I'll make sure my version matches yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You said you had it all handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I do. You're my final accuracy check. Read the confirmation on my phone and I'll type. We can use your spelling throughout, if that makes you happier.
